## Purpose

The Home landing screen: a data-driven grid of launchable workflow types plus a "Jump back in"
strip of recent runs, and the shared name/description modal used when saving or renaming a
workflow. Mounted by `DashboardLayout` for `mainView === "home"`/`"catalog"`, and its modal is
reused by `SavedWorkflowsPage`.

## Shape

- [HomeLaunchGrid.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/catalog/HomeLaunchGrid.tsx) — fetches launchable workflow definitions (`getWorkflowDefinitions`) and
  recent runs (`getWorkflows`) via a **stale-while-revalidate pattern**: seeds state
  synchronously from `sessionStorage` (or a pre-fetched prop from `page.tsx`) for instant
  render, then background-refetches to update the cache silently. Clicking a workflow card
  either routes to a wizard (`/workflow/create?mode=...`) for prototype/ppt or calls
  `onSelectFeature`. Also renders an inline "Inspect" affordance that opens `WorkflowDialog`.
- [NameWorkflowModal.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/catalog/NameWorkflowModal.tsx) — a name + optional-description modal with Save disabled until a name
  is entered. Deliberately built as a visual clone of `WorkflowHistory`'s `DeleteModal` plus
  `AgentsPopup`'s input styling, per the module's "no new visual language" mandate.

## Why this shape

`HomeLaunchGrid` owns its own cache (`vlc_home_workflows_v1`/`vlc_home_recents_v1` in
`sessionStorage`) so the home screen never blanks on revisit, independent of whatever
`page.tsx` has already fetched — **the prop and the cache are two paths to the same
instant-render goal**.

`NameWorkflowModal` lives here rather than in `ui/` because it is intentionally coupled to the
catalog/save-workflow flow (used by both the composer's "Save workflow" action and the
catalog's per-row rename), not a generic primitive.
